svg.aria-label: Three ways a farmer gives a bank consent, each with a national-ID login. 1, in person with a form (built): staff raise the request in the partner portal, the farmer logs in with the national ID and signs a form that staff upload, Consent Manager staff check it and the Farmer ID in the Farmer Registry, the bank queries and the Exchange finds the consent (no consent ID needed), and its admin downloads the consent record. 2, in person, digital (planned): after the national-ID login the farmer approves the request on the Consent Manager's screen; the consent is active at once and the farmer gets an SMS with a way to revoke. 3, self-service (planned): the farmer logs in to a portal or app, approves or declines, and can revoke later; the bank queries and the consent is looked up.
svg.text: How a farmer gives a bank consent
In every scenario the farmer proves who they are with the national ID. The consent lives in the Consent Manager, and the bank keeps a provable copy.
